## Checklist
- [ ] `gofmt -l .` prints nothing, `go vet ./...` and `go test ./...` pass
- [ ] Go standard library only (no new modules)
- [ ] New UI text has Korean and English entries
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` and the manuals updated if behavior or config keys changed
- [ ] No secrets, internal host names or real credentials in examples
